card.name: Inside the word suicidality in warnings
card.fires_on: The middle pieces (IC, ID) of the word suicidality or suicidal when split into parts. It appears in boxed warning headings about depression and suicidality.

modes.label: Start of suicid-
modes.description: The piece "IC" right after "SU" in boxed warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: DEPRESSION AND SU<<IC>>IDALITY Tetrabenazine tablets

modes.label: Middle of suicid-
modes.description: The piece "ID" after "SUIC" in the same kind of heading.
modes.example: WARNING: DEPRESSION AND SUIC<<ID>>ALITY Tetrabenazine tablets can
